so what are the types of e-commerce models?
The e-com services between businesses and consumers can be classified broadly in the following four categories:
**Business-to-Consumers (B2C)**
The most common type of business transaction involves selling products and services to individual consumers. For e.g. – Buying a t-shirt from an online store.
**Business-to-Business (B2B)**
Providing goods and services to other businesses falls under the category of B2B. For e.g. – our professional team developing an eCommerce website for your business.
**Consumer-to-Consumer (C2C)**
Consumers selling their previously purchased items to another consumer. For e.g. – an individual selling their used watch on eBay.
**Consumer to Business (C2B)**

When an individual provides value in the form of goods and services to businesses, it falls under the category of C2B. For e.g. – Blogger providing an affiliate link to a product in exchange for a fixed commission.

An online store can deal according to any of these eCommerce models. Based on the type of your business, your e-com platform can take up a variety of forms to offer transactions under categories such as:
Retail,
Drop Shipping,
Wholesale.
Crowdfunding.
Physical Products,
Services,
Subscription, etc.

blocks.text: Our Experts Integrate Hybrid Cloud & Cognitive Computing to add value to your business. We offer PaaS, IaaS and SaaS. We have knowledge and experience of Azure, Google cloud and AWS.
What is meant by a ‘Cloud’?
It is a visible mass of a huge amount of condensed water vapours floating all around in the sky.
Wait.
Is that what cloud services are all about?
Absolutely not.

**In the tech world, ‘cloud’** refers to the vast network of servers across the globe which are used to store and process data over the Internet. These servers essentially link together to form a single ecosystem. If we look at it broadly, the cloud is an allegory for the whole Internet as Cloud Services.

**Cloud-based services for Cloud Computing Services** are a wide range of services ranging from online storage and servers to development platforms and applications. This falls under the category of Information Technology (IT) services and is completely available on the Internet. The pricing system is based on the number of services/space you use. Therefore no going overboard with your budget.
How do Cloud Services work?

Cloud services are offered by a number of cloud service providers on the Internet. These are fully managed by the service providers so that the companies do not need to store data and programs on their servers.
What are the benefits of using Cloud Services?
**Scalable**
These services utilize a huge bunch of servers spread across different locations which makes the allocation and reallocation of resources fast.
**Reduced cost**
As its use can easily be modified as required, using a cloud service is cost-effective as compared to storing and accessing data through physical storage.
**Easy to manage**

Taking a subscription to a cloud service is not a permanent association. It can be procured on-demand and you can easily cancel the service if you do not need it anymore. This makes it easier for the buyers to handle the services according to their requirements.
What are the type of Cloud Services Available?
Is there a single type of cloud service?
No.
The most common types of cloud services offered on the Internet can be broadly classified as:
What are the benefits of using Cloud Services?
**Platform as a Service (PaaS)**

The PaaS providers offer the necessary hardware and software required by web developers to build a cloud-based application. They provide an environment that allows the developers to control the use of their applications on the cloud throughout its lifetime.
**Software as a Service (SaaS)**

It is the most widely known form of cloud service. Software as a service or SaaS comprises of various services such as cloud storage for backing up files and data, and web-based emails. This also includes several project management tools. This is offered on a periodic subscription basis.
**Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)**

In order to manage SaaS tools, many service providers require an infrastructure that is offered by IaaS service providers. Some of the giants of cloud-based services such as Amazon, Microsoft, Google, etc. offer such services.
They maintain large storage servers and networking hardware while also offering several other services. The payment is done according to the total usage by the customer.
Who are the major Cloud Services providers?
Here are some of the major providers of cloud-based services for cloud services:
**Amazon Web Services (AWS)**
Amazon has become one of the largest companies in the world, with its services ranging from selling books, to Artificial Intelligence and cloud computing as well.

Launched in the year 2006, Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a comprehensive cloud-based service provider. It includes all major types of cloud services namely PaaS, SaaS, and IaaS. Its pricing model is completely based on the usage of an individual customer or company. It provides a wide variety of cloud computing services for cloud computing services like cloud storage, servers, security, mobile development, etc.
AWS spans over more than 240 countries across the globe.
**Microsoft Azure**
The second-largest cloud-based service provider is another business giant, Microsoft.

With a market share of almost 2/10th of global usage, it provides a range of services such as cloud computing, storage, data analytics, and networking. Unlike AWS, it is also compatible with open source technologies. This enables the users to freely select from these services and develop their existing as well as new applications on the public cloud. The users are only charged for the services they avail.
Apart from these two major cloud service providers, there are a few Linux servers as well.

These are built on the open-sourced Linux operating system. As this is open-source, the clients can deliver their content, applications, and services to their users at affordable prices. It also provides optimized data security due to several enhanced permission settings.

blocks.text: Every time you face a doubt, where do you turn to?
GOOGLE.

In order to exist online, you need to devise a marketing strategy which can boost your reach and generate leads substantially. One of the major marketing formula to implement is **Search Engine Optimization (SEO).** This simply means using the right words in the right place.
Obviously, things are not as simple as that.
**What is SEO?**

Search Engine Optimization is all about knowing and implementing what can make your website visible. It focuses on attracting visitors organically by ranking higher in Google searches. This can be achieved through optimizing your website and content according to several factors that affect the rankings.
**Why is ranking high on search engines important for your website?**

Every day more than 3 billion searches are made on Google alone for SEO. This means there must be hundreds and thousands of people searching for answers every second that are relevant to your business. So for all the time you are not ranked high on Google, you miss out on visitors, leads, and eventually, money.

By optimizing your site according to the relevant keywords, you can tap into the enormous potential which the Internet offers for your business. This also ensures a smooth user experience for your new visitors as well as existing customers.
**What are we going to offer?**

We know how valuable customers are for your business. To make yourself visible amidst the chaos, your online presence requires clear planning and implementation of multiple strategies. This can boost your visibility on the Internet and significantly increase your sales too.
Always remember that SEO is not just for ranking higher on the search engines. It is also aimed at providing a better user experience for everybody that visits your website.

At Exult IT Solutions, we have a team of professionals with years of experience in the field of digital marketing. Our experts have worked with several brands and businesses to provide them with effective marketing solutions. The plans and strategies are made after we conduct an in-depth analysis of your business, requirements as well as your customer base. This rigorous research enables us to understand what is required and what exactly do your business needs.
Our SEO strategy is planned by experts and involves all the necessary procedures to rank your website higher in the relevant Google searches. This includes two major components:-
**On-Page Optimization**

As the name goes, this includes all the adjustments and modifications made on the website. This is inarguably the most visible aspect of SEO. A website has several elements that significantly impact the visitor’s decision-making as well as their user experience.

A major part of the on-page SEO includes optimizing content available on your website. This requires keyword research, optimized titles, meta descriptions, and tags. Several other features such as improving URLs, images, creating internal and external links also require modification.
Having a great website is useless at the end of the day if it does not performs well. Loading speed is an important thing to keep in mind while doing on-page optimization.
**Off-Page Optimization**

Off-page optimization goes beyond the work done on the website. This strategy includes building your brand’s credibility by generating enough backlinks on various reputed websites and platforms. When users come across your web link on a reputable website, it would create their trust in your brand.

Google does not entertain spam redirects to your website and one should always avoid this. Thus, creating relevant backlinks requires proper research and analysis. These links should be optimized according to subject relevance, anchor text, link location, etc.

A brand can take advantage of this strategy using social media, emails, guest blogging, and much more. This way you can reach a wider audience without sending out spam links to attract visitors to your website.
Our services also include:
**Mobile Optimization**

Mobile phone users have been on a meteoric rise in the past few years and almost every other person is connected to the Internet through this small device. Statistically, around 91% of the Internet users have mobile phones to go online every day.

Due to this increase, Google has started ranking websites based on their mobile-friendliness too. A website is not good enough if it does not respond well to mobile phones. Therefore a good website should be responsive to modern smartphones.
Mobile optimization requires a few basic steps:-
• Use a ‘responsive’ theme for your website. Nowadays, most templates and themes available online are suitable for mobile phones.
• The graphics used should not be too large in size. Unnecessarily large files take more time to load on phones and this could decrease user retention on your site.
• Clickable links and buttons should be added properly keeping in mind the small screen of mobile phones.
**Technical SEO**
Like every other technology, websites too can have some technical glitches. These obstacles while using the website potentially destroy your reputation and thus, affects your customer base.

The term Technical SEO refers to website optimization according to crawlers and web index. A proper technical SEO can ensure that the website is smoothly indexed by the search engines, preferably Google. This includes optimizing the URL structure, adding an SSL certificate and HTTPS, better website speed, registration with webmaster tools, etc.
why us?
It must be clear by now why a proper SEO strategy is necessary for your website. If your content does not show up actively in the search results, your business cannot sustain long enough.
